list.confirmDeactivateMsg: Deactivate {{username}}? They will not be able to sign in.
list.confirmDeleteMsg: Delete {{username}}? This action cannot be undone.
list.reactivateMsg: Reactivate {{username}}? They will be able to sign in again.
list.forceDeleteMessage: {{username}} has linked history (tickets, letters, comments, movements, etc.) that normally blocks deletion. As an administrator you can force the deletion: records with a mandatory author will be reassigned to your user and the rest will be left without an author. This action cannot be undone.

ADMIN.title: System Administrator
ADMIN.summary: Full control of catalogs, users, devices, tickets and reports.

MANAGER.title: Manager
MANAGER.summary: Oversees tickets and tasks in their department.
actions: Can complete tasks and close tickets

AREA_HEAD.title: Area head
AREA_HEAD.summary: Provides operational follow-up on their department's tickets.
actions: Can generate tasks from their tickets

EMPLOYEE.title: Employee
EMPLOYEE.summary: Carries out assigned tasks and reports progress.
actions: Only sees tickets with assigned tasks

HUMAN_RESOURCES.title: Human Resources
HUMAN_RESOURCES.summary: Manages the full personnel record (medical, official, contact data and documents).
actions: Views and edits the Personnel record
Does not manage tickets, inventory or users

GUARD.title: Guard
GUARD.summary: Runs the gatehouse from the app: scans staff credentials and records their entry or exit.
actions: Scans credentials and records entries/exits in the app
Sees their own records for the day
Does not see personnel records, inventory or users
